style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Traditional Wreath with Foliage
style.toneOfVoice: Welcome the season in style with this traditional 60cm wreath with metallic leaves—a luxurious twist on a festive favourite. This grand wreath features a lush bed of lifelike greenery, accented with gleaming metallic leaves that catch the light and add a refined shimmer to your holiday décor. Perfect for front doors, fireplaces, or statement walls, it brings together the warmth of tradition and the sparkle of sophistication. Whether your holiday style is classic, elegant, or glam, this wreath is designed to dazzle. Let this golden beauty be the shining star of your seasonal setup—where tradition meets a touch of luxe. Wreath width: D60cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
